mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may increase the metabolism of adapalene, potentially reducing its therapeutic efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause photosensitivity and skin irritation when used concurrently.
action: Monitor for reduced adapalene efficacy; counsel patient on strict photoprotection and watch for increased skin irritation; consider alternative retinoid or increased adapalene concentration if needed.
